_changelog_2026-09-08: enemy.base_health 30.0 -> 25.0 so projectile_damage 25.0 one-shots a full-health enemy; keep edits in THIS file (authoritative) in sync with core_env._DEFAULTS (fallback only - arena.json merges over it).
_changelog_2026-09-09: Style-2 always-dies fix + target leading (see FIX_PART2.md). Post-2026-09-08f the agent hunts spawners aggressively (5-9 spawner kills/ep, clears ~4 phases) exactly as section 5 intends, but style 2 died ~75-100% of the time -- always at phase 4-5, where enemy speed 4.4-5.9 vs player 6.0, spawn interval floored at 30 across 3-4 spawners, is near-unsurvivable for any policy. This is a demo/quality problem, not a reward-structure one. phase_curve.min_spawn_interval_steps 30 -> 45 (phase 4+ gets breathing room: an enemy every 15 steps per spawner instead of 10) and enemy_speed_gain_per_phase 0.5 -> 0.4 (phase-6 enemy 4.8 < player 6.0 so kiting stays viable at the tail). Paired with target leading in core_env._graded_aim_alignment so R_AIMED_HIT_BONUS rewards shots that will actually connect on a crossing target -- helps style 2, whose aim is welded to its cardinal movement. Retrain both styles.
_changelog_2026-09-08c: Glass-cannon fix (see FIX_PART2.md). The shipped ~1M-step tuned_v3/v4 models converged to an aggressive suicide policy (dies ~step 600-900 at phase ~3; 73%/47% death rate) because per-episode phase_progress (+158) + kills dominated R_DEATH (-100) -- surviving to the step cap was never reward-optimal. Fix (no new reward term): move the survival incentive onto the DAMAGE COST while KEEPING the world hostile enough that passivity still ~= death. A first 300k validation pass over-softened the world (contact 15, max_enemies 12, speed_gain 0.4, damage -1.0/HP) and the policy went passive -- survived to 1200 but wall-camped and stopped clearing spawners (phase 3.6 -> 0.25). FINAL values: enemy.contact_damage 25 -> 20 (5-hit margin, up from 4), enemy.max_concurrent_enemies kept at 18 (was briefly 12; keep swarm pressure), phase_curve.enemy_speed_gain_per_phase 0.55 -> 0.5 (minor tail softening only), observation.num_active_enemies_max 12 -> 18 (match max_concurrent, fixes a real normalisation mismatch), player.rotate_speed_rad 0.14 -> 0.2 (~30% faster reorientation, cuts the style-1 'nosed into a wall while swarmed' stall). Paired with R_DAMAGE_TAKEN_PER_HP -0.5 -> -0.7 in rewards_config.py. Retrain both styles after this change.
_notes: Single source of truth for Part II environment parameters, mirroring part1_gridworld/config/training_config.json. core_env.py / phases.py / obs.py should load this from CONFIG_DIR/arena.json once implemented rather than hardcoding module constants (ARENA_WIDTH/ARENA_HEIGHT/DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS are kept as fallbacks). max_steps was reduced from the original 3000 so a 300k-timestep run sees a usable number of episode terminations (see docs/AUDIT_main.md 5.4). phase_curve and curriculum values feed phases.py::difficulty_for_phase (see its docstring for the ramp schedule). num_active_enemies_max is the normalisation divisor for the num_active_enemies_frac observation feature (docs/AUDIT_main.md 7.4) and should equal enemy.max_concurrent_enemies. REBALANCE HISTORY (report section 4): 2026-08-28 raised enemy speed (base_enemy_speed 1.6->2.4) and shortened spawn intervals (base 120->70, min 40->30) and made enemies non-kamikaze, killing the free corner-camp; 2026-09-08 bumped contact_damage to 25 for 'aggressiveness'; 2026-09-08c (see _changelog_2026-09-08c) walked contact_damage back to 20, softened enemy_speed_gain_per_phase 0.55->0.5, aligned num_active_enemies_max to max_concurrent (18), raised rotate_speed_rad 0.14->0.2 and paired it with R_DAMAGE_TAKEN_PER_HP -0.5->-0.7 to stop the resulting suicide policy without letting wall-camping become viable again. All values are tuning knobs reported in report section 4.
